Stormsurge

2800 goldFinished item

A mage item with ability power, magic penetration and move speed: dealing 25% of a champion's max health within 2.5 seconds triggers extra magic damage on them.

Stats

  • 90 Ability Power
  • 15 Magic Penetration
  • 6% Move Speed

What it does

Stormraider: Dealing 25% of a champion's maximum Health within 2.5s applies Squall to them.

Squall: After 2 seconds, deal magic damage. If the target dies before Squall triggers, it damages nearby enemies.

When to buy it

Buy it on burst mages who deal a lot of damage quickly to one target.
